_meta.purpose: Mirror the customer OTel-logs schema for PPL perf/load/use-case mock indices.
notes: Body-format variation (kv/json-*/nested) is CONTENT variation ingested into THIS single schema via the 5 dynamic_templates; not separate mappings.
number_of_shards is a Tier knob: Tier-1 local = 1; Tier-2 sized to ~12.8GB/shard per the sizing doc.
data_stream => append-only, auto _id, op_type=create. If controlled custom-_id seeding is needed for expected-value correctness, switch to plain indices + rollover alias.
_meta.note: ~3000-field OTel-faithful stress schema: sparse cols in attributes.* and resource.attributes.* (NO log.** explosion -- non-OTel + unqueried)
